200 m MAXIMUM / TWO IMAGINED 100 m BLOCKS
Four deep hourglass bays follow the red-marked reference; circular floor plates narrow at each waist.
Four 4 m-wide stair ribbons connect all 100 floors via landings and bridges; vertical ribs removed.
